definitions.explanation: High-quality ceramic material made from kaolin, fired at high temperatures to create a hard, white, translucent surface.

examples.english: China is known as the birthplace of porcelain.

notes:
{磁器|じき} refers specifically to porcelain, the finest type of ceramic.
